import subprocess
import threading


def make(argv):
    def run():
        subprocess.run(argv)
    return run


cmd = ["pacman", "-S", "r22-cx8-compose"]
t = threading.Thread(target=make(cmd))
cmd = ["pacman", "-Q", "r22-cx8-decoy"]
t.run()
